# About
Vulcan's Vault is a Datapack/Mod that spices up Minecraft's loot by adding new weapon and tool variants for you to discover. Find exclusive new styles for your favorite tools weapons, or discover brand new ones that possess new abilities! Whether it be exploring end cities and piglin bastions, or just fishing in a pond, there is something to find! Rumors even speak of some more *ominous* items that possess powerful abilities- but at a cost.

The following places contain items from this pack: Abandoned Mineshafts, Ancient Cities, Bastions, Buried Treasure, Desert Pyramids, End Cities, Nether Fortresses, Shipwrecks, Dungeons, Strongholds and Fishing.

_**!! NOTE !!**  This pack is currently in an early beta. Expect to see bugs or unfinished features. More content is also subject to be added in the future, so some areas may currently lack content from our pack. If you would like to help support our development by providing feedback and ideas, join our discord in the link below!_
